slides.title: Ethiopia's displaced, in numbers
slides.body: Explainer: UNHCR data reported by The Rio Times, Nov 6, 2026

slides.title: people displaced inside Ethiopia
slides.body: As of Aug 31, 2026, per a UNHCR data sheet. It predates the latest fighting since October.

slides.title: displaced by conflict
slides.body: Social tension 9%, drought 4%, other causes 5%, the UNHCR sheet shows.

slides.title: refugees and asylum seekers hosted
slides.body: Mostly from South Sudan, Somalia, Eritrea and Sudan. 53% are children.

slides.title: Every one of them needs protection and aid access.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: UNHCR data (Aug 31, 2026) via The Rio Times, Nov 6, 2026
